title: CoralMessage
description:
One coral message as published to JetStream and read by relays and the
serve edge. Field names are the wire; `timestamp` serializes as RFC 3339.

testimony.description:
Absent only on messages from pre-EST-178 senders; a verifier renders
those as UNATTESTED rather than failing to parse them.

MessageKind.description: Variant names ARE the wire values (see [`Priority`]).

oneOf.description: Direct message to another operator's agent
Request for attention — injects into terminal immediately
Task handoff — creates a Linear ticket + notifies
Escalation — injects + plays sound + creates Linear ticket

Priority.description:
Variant names ARE the wire values (`"Info"`, `"Action"`, `"Escalation"`):
this vocabulary predates the domain crate and messages carrying it are
already in the reef, so it is not lowercased like the reflex enums.

Testimony.description:
Hash-on-send attestation. Author *signing* (key-backed attestation) is
deliberately not here yet — it needs key distribution, which is a design
EST-178 does not specify. `body_hash` is the day-one testimony posture.
